 3 hours ago Liverpool make five changes at Crystal Palace this afternoon.
 By James Carroll
 Previous Next The Reds recall Ronald Araujo and Milos Kerkez in defence at Selhurst Park.
 Meanwhile, Cody Gakpo, Alexander Isak and Florian Wirtz also return for the Premier League fixture.
 Liverpool: Alisson, Van Dijk, Jacquet, Kerkez, Wirtz, Szoboszlai, Isak, Mac Allister, Gakpo, Barcola, Araujo.
 Subs: Mamardashvili, Gomez, Endo, Tsimikas, Munoz, Nyoni, McConnell, Koumas, Ngumoha.
